verdict.rationale: Team sharing of TOTP logins through shared vaults with per-member access control is a fair question for an authenticator product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows multi-device sync and device management within a single personal account. One community report describes handing a whole Authy account to a coworker, which is a user-side workaround, not a team-sharing feature.

support.subject: As an IT admin, my team can share TOTP-protected logins through shared vaults or collections with per-member access control
